facts.fact: The Global Fund says 1,254 health facilities were implementing the Impilo EMR as of August 2025, with deployment planned for all 1,900 health facilities; the count is of all health facilities, not primary clinics alone.
The Global Fund says the Government of Zimbabwe has been developing a national EMR system since February 2015, culminating in the current system, Impilo, for use in public health facilities.

The Global Fund says it has put over US$43.1 million into digital health in Zimbabwe since 2014 (US$9.85 million of it in the 2024-2026 grant cycle), with its Digital Health Impact Accelerator focused on interoperable patient-level medical record systems and its support paying for FHIR adoption in Impilo; the document names no domestic budget line.

The Global Fund says the Government of Zimbabwe and partners have strengthened the national health management information system for routine reporting of key health metrics, and that Global Fund financing supports data analysis and capacity building at sub-national levels; the document names no domestic budget line.
